rationale: The macOS GPU device headers under core/render forward to gpu-runtime (the Vellum repository's dependency-free gpu-runtime/ subproject) under PULP_GPU_RUNTIME: the same types under their Pulp names. All twelve touched headers change text (a forwarding branch, or their forward declarations moving to pulp/platform/gpu_fwd.hpp), but none changes behavior, and builds without PULP_GPU_RUNTIME compile the original bodies. No rendering behavior, design-import, Chromium or packaging authority moves. Vellum must never define PULP_GPU_RUNTIME when it builds mirrored sources.
